blocks.sub_domain: Cross-Role Translation & Daily Course Manifest Ingestion

content.core_principle: The four roles (Groundsman, Greenkeeper/Agronomist, Architect, Golfer/Caddy) share a unified spatial reality. The Daily Course Manifest translates morning TDR 350 moisture probes, GS3 Stimp rolls, and QGIS vector master plans into real-time Caddy/PUTTSER rollout numbers.

cross_role_triggers.high_moisture_vwc: Reduces rollout distance by 18 inches per 10% VWC increase; prompts aerial carry strategy.
cross_role_triggers.gs3_firmness: Modulates normal rebound vector in 3-DoF solver.
cross_role_triggers.illegal_pin_warning: Flags warning if Stimp speed exceeds stopping threshold on >3% green grade.
